name: PDF Watermark (Text, Image, Tiled)

seo.title: PDF Watermark (Text, Image, Tiled) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Apply text or image watermarks to PDF pages locally, including centred and tiled layouts.

assumptions: Watermarks are added as new page content, not as annotations.
limitations: Watermarks are deterrents, not access controls; recipients with PDF-editing tools may be able to remove them.
